cards.title: Confirm Vue APIs before choosing component design
cards.when: Before writing a form component, confirm the installed Vue version and check whether the project already uses defineModel.
cards.cmds:
jq -r .dependencies.vue package.json
npm ls vue
rg -n 'defineModel' src

cards.title: Plan the empty-state test cases before building
cards.when: Before writing code, decide the test file location and the exact cases so the build stage has a checkable target.
cards.cmds:
find tests -name '*.spec.ts'
jq -r .devDependencies.@vue/test-utils package.json
npx vitest --version

cards.title: Verify nav search form blocks empty submission with Playwright
cards.when: Use this after adding validation to a search form inside a React nav bar, to prove that an empty submit shows an error and does not navigate.
cards.cmds:
cat playwright.config.ts
npx playwright test tests/nav-search.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/nav-search.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Verify login field error linked with aria-describedby
cards.when: Use this when a nav login form shows an inline error under an email field and you must confirm assistive technology can read it.
cards.cmds:
npm install --save-dev @axe-core/playwright
npx playwright test tests/nav-login-a11y.spec.ts
grep -n 'aria-describedby' src/components/NavLogin.jsx

cards.title: Unit-test nav form validation with Vitest and Testing Library
cards.when: Use this to verify a validation hook or nav form component before wiring it into the page, with fast tests that run in Node.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run src/nav/useNavSearchValidation.test.ts
npx vitest run src/nav/NavSearchForm.test.tsx
npx vitest run src/nav --reporter=verbose

cards.title: Verify nav submit button meets 44px touch target
cards.when: Use this when a nav form is used on touch screens and you must prove the submit control is large enough to tap.
cards.cmds:
npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173/ --only-categories=accessibility --chrome-flags=--headless
npx playwright test tests/nav-touch-targets.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify nav form submit blocks reload on Enter key
cards.when: Use this after adding an onSubmit handler to a nav form, to confirm that pressing Enter runs validation and does not reload the page.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'onSubmit' src/nav
npx playwright test tests/nav-keyboard.spec.ts --project=chromium
npx playwright test tests/nav-keyboard.spec.ts --grep no-request

cards.title: Lint nav form labels and types with jsx-a11y
cards.when: Use this before merging nav form changes, to catch unlabeled inputs and type errors in the validation props.
cards.cmds:
npx eslint src/nav --rule jsx-a11y/label-has-associated-control:error
npx tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run src/nav/NavSearchForm.test.tsx

cards.title: Choose validation timing per field
cards.when: Use when deciding whether each row validates on blur, on input, or on submit, especially for async checks.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 200ms docs/rows-plan.md
rg -n 'fetch' src/lib
rg -n 'oninput' src/lib

cards.title: Key row errors by row id, not index
cards.when: Use when rows can be added, removed, or reordered, so each row's errors must stay with that row.
cards.cmds:
rg -n '#each' src/lib
npx vitest run src/lib/validation/rows.test.ts

cards.title: Put row rules in a plain TypeScript module
cards.when: Use when validation must be shared by the list component and the server action and tested without a browser.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/lib/validation
touch src/lib/validation/rows.ts
touch src/lib/validation/rows.test.ts
npx vitest run src/lib/validation/rows.test.ts
grep -c svelte src/lib/validation/rows.ts

cards.title: Set row limits and touch target sizes in the plan
cards.when: Use when planning the list bounds: minimum rows, maximum rows, the add and remove button sizes, and the empty state.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 50 docs/rows-plan.md
npx axe http://localhost:5173/rows

cards.title: Inventory row fields and rules before writing code
cards.when: Use this first when planning a Svelte list form, to fix the exact fields and the rules each row must satisfy.
cards.cmds:
rg -l '#each' src
touch docs/rows-plan.md
wc -l docs/rows-plan.md
npx svelte-check --threshold error

cards.title: Verify layout shift stays under budget with Lighthouse
cards.when: A Vue layout page has been built and you must prove it does not shift content while loading.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
npx vite preview --port 4173
npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173/layout --only-categories=performance --chrome-flags=--headless=new --output=json --output-path=lh-layout.json
jq '.audits["cumulative-layout-shift"].numericValue' lh-layout.json

cards.title: Check that the lazy-loaded layout chunk stays under 50 KB
cards.when: A layout panel is split into its own chunk with defineAsyncComponent and you must confirm its size.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
find dist/assets -name "*.js" -size +50k
ls -l dist/assets

cards.title: Prove a virtual list renders only visible rows
cards.when: A Vue layout uses a virtualized list of many rows and you must confirm the DOM stays small.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p tests
touch tests/virtual-grid.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/virtual-grid.spec.ts

cards.title: Assert a layout component mounts under 200ms
cards.when: A Vue layout component is heavy and you must prove its mount time stays within budget.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p tests
touch tests/LayoutGrid.mount.spec.ts
npx vitest run tests/LayoutGrid.mount.spec.ts

cards.title: Count re-renders of a layout component after a state change
cards.when: A parent layout updates state and you must confirm children do not re-render more than needed.
cards.cmds:
rg -n onUpdated src
mkdir -p tests
touch tests/LayoutChild.rerender.spec.ts
npx vitest run tests/LayoutChild.rerender.spec.ts

cards.title: Confirm a layout ResizeObserver is disconnected on unmount
cards.when: A Vue layout component observes its size and you must prove the observer is cleaned up to avoid leaks.
cards.cmds:
rg -n disconnect src
mkdir -p tests
touch tests/LayoutGrid.observer.spec.ts
npx vitest run tests/LayoutGrid.observer.spec.ts

cards.title: Add a skip-to-content link before the nav
cards.when: Use when a page header with a navigation menu comes before the main content and keyboard users need a way to bypass the repeated links.
cards.cmds:
test -f src/app/layout.tsx
npx playwright test tests/skip-link.spec.ts
npx axe http://localhost:3000/ --exit --tags wcag2a

cards.title: Mark the current nav link with aria-current
cards.when: Use when a navigation menu lists site sections and the active item must be exposed to assistive technology and shown visually.
cards.cmds:
test -f src/components/Nav.tsx
grep -c aria-current src/components/Nav.tsx
npx playwright test tests/nav-current.spec.ts

cards.title: Build a menu toggle with aria-expanded and aria-controls
cards.when: Use when the navigation collapses into a hidden panel below the md breakpoint and the button must announce whether the menu is open or closed.
cards.cmds:
grep -c md: src/components/Nav.tsx
npx playwright test tests/mobile-menu.spec.ts

cards.title: Give nav links a visible focus ring
cards.when: Use when nav links look fine with a mouse but keyboard focus is invisible or removed by outline-none.
cards.cmds:
grep -n outline-none src/components/Nav.tsx
grep -c outline-none src/components/Nav.tsx
npx axe http://localhost:3000/ --exit --tags wcag21aa

cards.title: Remove nav drawer motion for reduced-motion users
cards.when: Use when the navigation drawer slides or fades with transitions and users who set prefers-reduced-motion need that motion removed.
cards.cmds:
grep -c transition src/components/Nav.tsx
npx playwright test tests/reduced-motion.spec.ts
grep -c motion-reduce src/components/Nav.tsx

cards.title: Give each nav landmark a unique accessible name
cards.when: Use when a page has more than one nav, such as a header menu and a footer menu, and each needs a distinct accessible name.
cards.cmds:
grep -rc '<nav' src/components
grep -rn aria-label src/components
npx axe http://localhost:3000/ --exit --tags best-practice
npx playwright test tests/nav-landmarks.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify tab skeleton disappears after panel data loads
cards.when: Use this after wiring a loading skeleton into a Tailwind tab panel to prove it clears when the tab's data arrives.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'animate-pulse' src/components/Tabs.tsx
npx playwright test tests/tabs-loading.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/tabs-loading.spec.ts --grep 'empty state'

cards.title: Verify tab panel exposes aria-busy while loading
cards.when: Use this when a tab panel fetches content so assistive tech can tell the region is still updating.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'aria-busy' src/components/Tabs.tsx
npx vitest run src/components/Tabs.test.tsx
rg -c 'role="tabpanel"' src/components/Tabs.tsx

cards.title: Verify compiled Tailwind CSS includes loading utilities
cards.when: Use this when loading classes look correct in source but may be missing from the built stylesheet.
cards.cmds:
npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./src/index.css -o ./dist/tabs.css
rg -c 'animate-pulse' dist/tabs.css
rg -c 'motion-reduce' dist/tabs.css
stat -c %s dist/tabs.css

cards.title: Verify loading panel passes axe contrast and roles
cards.when: Use this before merging a tabs loading state to confirm the rendered page has no accessibility violations.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev
npx axe http://localhost:5173/tabs --exit

cards.title: Verify Lighthouse accessibility score for tabs route
cards.when: Use this as a repeatable gate that confirms the tabs page scores well on accessibility after the loading state changes.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p reports
npx lighthouse http://localhost:5173/tabs --only-categories=accessibility --output=json --output-path=./reports/tabs.json
jq '.categories.accessibility.score' reports/tabs.json

cards.title: Verify keyboard navigation keeps aria-selected during loading
cards.when: Use this when tabs can be switched while a panel is still loading, to confirm arrow keys move selection and focus.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'role="tab"' src/components/Tabs.tsx
npx vitest run src/components/Tabs.keyboard.test.tsx
npx playwright test tests/tabs-keyboard.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Verify chart typography tokens compile into Tailwind utilities
cards.when: Use after adding chart font-size tokens to an @theme block to confirm Tailwind generates the matching text-* utilities.
cards.cmds:
rg -n '@theme' src/styles/input.css
npx @tailwindcss/cli -i src/styles/input.css -o dist/app.css
rg -cF 'text-chart-label' dist/app.css
rg -nF 'text-chart-label:' dist/app.css

cards.title: Verify chart components use no raw color or size literals
cards.when: Use before merging chart components to confirm colors and font sizes come from tokens rather than literal values.
cards.cmds:
find src/components/chart -name '*.tsx'
rg -n '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,6}' src/components/chart
rg -nF 'text-[' src/components/chart
rg -nF 'style={{' src/components/chart

cards.title: Verify chart tick labels meet size and numeral rules
cards.when: Use after building a chart page to measure rendered tick label font size and tabular numerals in a real browser.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev
npx playwright test tests/chart-typography.spec.ts
rg -nF 'toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(12)' tests/chart-typography.spec.ts
rg -nF 'tabular-nums' tests/chart-typography.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify chart axis text passes WCAG AA contrast
cards.when: Use after changing chart label or axis colors to confirm text contrast meets WCAG AA in the rendered page.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev
npx axe http://localhost:3000/charts/revenue --tags wcag21aa --exit
rg -nF 'color-chart-axis' src/styles/input.css
rg -nF 'text-chart-axis' src/components/chart

cards.title: Verify chart series fills meet 3:1 non-text contrast
cards.when: Use after choosing series colors to confirm each fill meets the 3:1 non-text contrast minimum against the plot background.
cards.cmds:
rg -nF 'color-chart-' src/styles/input.css
rg -nF 'fill-chart-' src/components/chart
npx playwright test tests/chart-fill-contrast.spec.ts
rg -nF 'toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(3)' tests/chart-fill-contrast.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify dark mode chart tokens override every light value
cards.when: Use after adding dark mode chart colors to confirm each light token also has a dark override in the built CSS.
cards.cmds:
rg -cF '--color-chart-1:' src/styles/input.css
npx @tailwindcss/cli -i src/styles/input.css -o dist/app.css
rg -cF '--color-chart-1:' dist/app.css
rg -nF '.dark' dist/app.css
npx playwright test tests/chart-dark-tokens.spec.ts

cards.title: Cap visible toasts with a shallowRef queue
cards.when: Use when a Vue app can fire many toasts at once and the DOM must stay bounded.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/composables
npx vue-tsc --noEmit
grep -n MAX_VISIBLE src/composables/useToast.ts

cards.title: Animate toast stack with stable keys
cards.when: Use when toasts enter and leave a list and the animation must target the right element.
cards.cmds:
npx eslint src/components/ToastContainer.vue
grep -c toast.id src/components/ToastContainer.vue

cards.title: Teleport a single toast host to body
cards.when: Use when toasts must render above the app regardless of the component that triggered them.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run src/components/ToastContainer.spec.ts
grep -rn Teleport src

cards.title: Track toast timers outside reactive state
cards.when: Use when each toast auto-dismisses after a delay and timer bookkeeping must not trigger renders.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run src/composables/useToast.spec.ts
grep -n clearTimeout src/components/Toast.vue

cards.title: Skip unchanged toasts with v-memo
cards.when: Use when a toast list re-renders often and most items do not change between updates.
cards.cmds:
npx eslint src/components/ToastContainer.vue
npx vitest run tests/toast-render.bench.spec.ts
grep -n v-memo src/components/ToastContainer.vue

cards.title: Batch toast bursts into one flush
cards.when: Use when several toasts are pushed in the same tick and the stack should update once.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run src/composables/useToast.batch.spec.ts
grep -n queueMicrotask src/composables/useToast.ts
npx vue-tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Loading sheet with spinner and disabled submit button
cards.when: Use when a SwiftUI sheet must show a spinner and block its submit action while an async request runs.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p Sources/Modals
touch Sources/Modals/LoadingSheet.swift
test -f Sources/Modals/LoadingSheet.swift
grep -c disabled Sources/Modals/LoadingSheet.swift

cards.title: Block swipe dismiss while sheet is loading
cards.when: Use when a SwiftUI sheet must stay open during a request so a swipe-down cannot discard an in-flight save.
cards.cmds:
grep -c interactiveDismissDisabled Sources/Modals/LoadingSheet.swift
grep -c isLoading Sources/Modals/LoadingSheet.swift
grep -n isLoading Sources/Modals/LoadingSheet.swift

cards.title: Show skeleton placeholder after 200ms delay
cards.when: Use when a SwiftUI sheet loads quickly most of the time and the placeholder should appear only if the wait is noticeable.
cards.cmds:
touch Sources/Modals/ProfileSheet.swift
grep -c milliseconds Sources/Modals/ProfileSheet.swift
grep -c redacted Sources/Modals/ProfileSheet.swift

cards.title: Cancel in-flight load when sheet disappears
cards.when: Use when a SwiftUI sheet starts a manual Task for a network call and that call must stop when the sheet closes.
cards.cmds:
touch Sources/Modals/SearchSheet.swift
grep -c onDisappear Sources/Modals/SearchSheet.swift
grep -c cancel Sources/Modals/SearchSheet.swift
grep -n cancel Sources/Modals/SearchSheet.swift

cards.title: Verify empty state contrast meets WCAG AA in both themes
cards.when: Use after building a React EmptyState that reads theme tokens, before merging light and dark mode changes.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev -- --port 5173
npx axe http://localhost:5173/empty --tags wcag2aa --exit
npx playwright test tests/empty-state-dark.spec.ts

cards.title: Assert empty state background flips under dark color scheme
cards.when: Use when the app follows prefers-color-scheme and you need proof the EmptyState surface changes in dark mode.
cards.cmds:
npm install -D @playwright/test
npx playwright install chromium
npx playwright test tests/empty-state-theme.spec.ts --project=chromium

cards.title: Reject hardcoded hex colors in EmptyState styles
cards.when: Use before reviewing an EmptyState component to confirm every color comes from theme tokens so dark mode can override it.
cards.cmds:
grep -rnE '#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}' src/components/EmptyState
rg -n -F 'var(--' src/components/EmptyState
npx vitest run src/components/EmptyState.test.tsx

cards.title: Gate empty state accessibility score in dark theme
cards.when: Use after the dark theme for the empty route is wired, to get a repeatable accessibility score for CI.
cards.cmds:
env VITE_DEFAULT_THEME=dark npm run dev -- --port 5173
npx lighthouse http://localhost:5173/empty --only-categories=accessibility --output=json --output-path=./lh-empty-dark.json --chrome-flags=--headless
jq '.categories.accessibility.score' ./lh-empty-dark.json

cards.title: Type-check theme token keys used by EmptyState
cards.when: Use when EmptyState reads a typed theme object, so a misspelled token key fails at build time instead of rendering an unstyled empty state.
cards.cmds:
npx tsc --noEmit
npx eslint src/components/EmptyState.tsx src/theme/tokens.ts
grep -n ': any' src/components/EmptyState.tsx

cards.title: Assert theme toggle repaints empty state within 200ms
cards.when: Use when a theme toggle changes the empty state surface and you need proof the switch is fast enough to avoid a visible flicker.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tests/theme-toggle-timing.spec.ts --project=chromium
npx playwright test tests/theme-toggle-timing.spec.ts --repeat-each=5 --project=chromium

cards.title: Set contrast targets for select text and borders
cards.when: Use this when the plan must fix the minimum contrast values for select labels, borders, and focus rings in both themes.
cards.cmds:
touch docs/select_theme_plan.md
grep -n "4.5:1" docs/select_theme_plan.md
grep -n "3:1" docs/select_theme_plan.md

cards.title: Define the five table states before building
cards.when: Use when a table's data comes from a slow source and the plan must name every display state.
cards.cmds:
pytest --collect-only -q tests
rg -n loading src
grep -c "^- " PLAN.md

cards.title: Plan a 200ms delay before showing the spinner
cards.when: Use when a fast fetch would flash the loading indicator, so the plan needs a debounce threshold.
cards.cmds:
rg -n set_timer src
python3 -c "from textual.timer import Timer"
grep -n 200ms PLAN.md

cards.title: Confirm which TUI library the project already depends on
cards.when: Use when the repo might be Textual, Ratatui, or Ink, and the plan must name the one in use.
cards.cmds:
ls
npm ls ink
cargo tree -i ratatui

cards.title: Plan a 5-second timeout that moves loading to error
cards.when: Use when a table fetch can hang, so the plan needs a deadline and an error state.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -e requests -e httpx src
pip show httpx
grep -c 5000ms PLAN.md

cards.title: Plan skeleton row count from terminal height
cards.when: Use when the loading placeholder must fill the visible table area without forcing scrolling.
cards.cmds:
echo $LINES $COLUMNS
python3 -c "print(24 - 3 - 1)"

cards.title: Verify submit button enables only when form is valid
cards.when: A Svelte signup form disables its submit button until native validation passes, and you need to prove that in a real browser.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p tests
touch tests/signup-button.spec.ts
npx vite dev --port 5173
grep -rn 'Create account' src
npx playwright test --list
npx playwright test tests/signup-button.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Unit-test Svelte button shows aria-invalid on empty submit
cards.when: You wrote a reusable Svelte 5 button component that wraps a form submit and must confirm it sets error state without a browser.
cards.cmds:
grep -n testing-library package.json
touch src/lib/components/SubmitButton.test.ts
npx vitest run src/lib/components/SubmitButton.test.ts

cards.title: Type-check button props and bindings with svelte-check
cards.when: You added typed props or bind:value to a Svelte button or form field and need to catch type errors before merging.
cards.cmds:
grep -n props src/lib/components/SubmitButton.svelte
npx svelte-check --threshold error
npx svelte-check --threshold error

cards.title: Prove double-submit is blocked while the button is pending
cards.when: Your Svelte form uses use:enhance with a pending state, and you must confirm one click sends exactly one request.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/double-submit.spec.ts
npx vite dev --port 5173
npx playwright test tests/double-submit.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Check button tap target is at least 44px tall
cards.when: You styled a Svelte submit button for touch use and must verify its clickable height meets the 44px minimum.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/button-target-size.spec.ts
grep -n min-height src/lib/components/SubmitButton.svelte
npx playwright test tests/button-target-size.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Run axe on the invalid form state for button and error labels
cards.when: Your Svelte signup form shows an error message beside the submit button and you need to confirm the invalid state passes automated accessibility checks.
cards.cmds:
npx vite dev --port 5173
npx @axe-core/cli http://localhost:5173/signup --exit

cards.title: Render shimmer skeleton rows for a loading list
cards.when: Use when a plain HTML list is fetched on page load and placeholder rows should show while the data is pending.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p list-loading
grep -c 'list-item skeleton' list-loading/index.html

cards.title: Mark list busy and announce load completion
cards.when: Use when a list container is still fetching items and assistive technology should know the region is updating.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'aria-busy' list-loading/index.html
grep -n 'role' list-loading/index.html
npx axe http://localhost:8080/list-loading/

cards.title: Disable shimmer animation under reduced motion
cards.when: Use when skeleton rows animate and the styles must respect users who set reduced motion in their OS.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'prefers-reduced-motion' list-loading/styles.css
npx playwright test tests/reduced-motion.spec.js

cards.title: Clone placeholder rows from a template element
cards.when: Use when the list shell is static HTML and you want to stamp out N skeleton rows with JavaScript without duplicating markup.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p list-template
grep -c '<template' list-template/index.html
node --check list-template/app.js

cards.title: Lazy-load list thumbnails with reserved dimensions
cards.when: Use when list items include thumbnails and the page should avoid layout shift while images below the fold load.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p list-thumbs
grep -c 'lazy' list-thumbs/index.html
npx lighthouse http://localhost:8080/list-thumbs/ --only-categories=performance --output=json --output-path=list-thumbs/report.json --quiet

cards.title: Show load-more button with busy state and 44px target
cards.when: Use when a list loads more pages on demand and the Load more button must show progress and remain accessible.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p list-more
grep -n 'min-height: 44px' list-more/styles.css
npx playwright test tests/load-more.spec.js

cards.title: Render no toast DOM when the queue is empty
cards.when: Use when building ToastContainer.vue so an empty toast queue adds no wrapper or live region to the page.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/composables src/components/__tests__
touch src/composables/useToast.ts
touch src/components/ToastContainer.vue
npx vitest run src/components/__tests__/ToastContainer.spec.ts

cards.title: Normalize unknown thrown values into a safe error message
cards.when: Use when toast.error receives an Error, a string, an object, null, or undefined from a failed request.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/utils
touch src/utils/toErrorMessage.ts
touch src/utils/toErrorMessage.spec.ts
npx vitest run src/utils/toErrorMessage.spec.ts

cards.title: Keep error toasts sticky with role alert
cards.when: Use when adding the error variant so failures stay visible until dismissed and are announced immediately.
cards.cmds:
touch src/components/Toast.vue src/components/__tests__/Toast.spec.ts
npx vitest run src/components/__tests__/Toast.spec.ts
grep -n role src/components/Toast.vue

cards.title: Cap visible toasts at three and drop the oldest
cards.when: Use when a burst of notifications would otherwise stack more toasts than the screen can show.
cards.cmds:
touch src/composables/useToast.spec.ts
npx vitest run src/composables/useToast.spec.ts
grep -n MAX_VISIBLE src/composables/useToast.ts

cards.title: Verify error toast with Playwright and axe
cards.when: Use after the error toast renders on the demo page to confirm it is announced and passes the WCAG AA contrast rule.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/toast-error.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/toast-error.spec.ts --project=chromium
npx axe http://localhost:5173/toast-demo --tags wcag2aa
grep -n 44px src/components/Toast.vue

cards.title: Give each toast a unique key for TransitionGroup
cards.when: Use when rendering queued toasts with v-for inside TransitionGroup so repeated messages do not collide.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run src/composables/useToast.spec.ts
grep -c :key src/components/ToastContainer.vue

cards.title: Set text contrast budget for empty-state tokens
cards.when: Use this when choosing foreground and background token pairs for the empty-state text in the Vue app.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -- '--color-' src/styles/tokens.css
npx axe http://localhost:5173/empty

cards.title: Plan EmptyState.vue props for typography overrides
cards.when: Use this when deciding the script setup prop interface for an EmptyState.vue component that accepts title and description text.
cards.cmds:
npm ls vue
ls src/components

cards.title: Map empty-state title and body to type tokens
cards.when: Use this when deciding which existing font-size tokens the EmptyState.vue heading and description should use.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'rem' src/styles
touch plan/empty-state-type.md
grep -n font-size-lg src/styles/tokens.css
grep -n font-size-base src/styles/tokens.css

cards.title: Verify planned token names exist before building
cards.when: Use this as the last planning check, before writing EmptyState.vue, to confirm every token name in the plan exists in the tokens file.
cards.cmds:
grep -c font-size-lg src/styles/tokens.css
grep -c font-size-base src/styles/tokens.css
grep -c color-text-muted src/styles/tokens.css

npx vue-tsc --noEmit
npm run build

cards.title: Keep long modal content scrollable within viewport height
cards.when: Modal bodies may hold forms or long text that exceeds the visible screen height.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/components tests
python3 -c "open('src/components/AppModal.css','w').write('.modal-dialog { max-height: 90dvh~ display: flex~ flex-direction: column~ }{NL}.modal-body { overflow-y: auto~ flex-grow: 1~ min-height: 0~ …
python3 -c "open('tests/modal-scroll.spec.ts','w').write('import { test, expect } from {DQ}@playwright/test{DQ}{NL}import { readFileSync } from {DQ}fs{DQ}{NL}test({DQ}modal body scrolls at 667px view…
npx playwright test tests/modal-scroll.spec.ts

cards.title: Semantic empty state with one labeled heading and message
cards.when: A list, table, or search view has no items and needs a labeled empty message.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn aria-labelledby src/components
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Touch-sized empty-state action with visible focus ring
cards.when: The empty state has a primary button that keyboard and touch users must reach and see.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn focus-visible src/components
npx tailwindcss -i src/index.css -o dist/app.css
grep -c min-h-11 dist/app.css
npx playwright test tests/empty-state-focus.spec.ts

cards.title: Hide decorative empty-state icon and keep text contrast
cards.when: The empty state shows a large decorative illustration or icon above its heading and message.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn aria-hidden src/components/EmptyState.tsx
npx @axe-core/cli http://localhost:5173/empty --exit

cards.title: Announce empty-state changes through a polite live region
cards.when: Filtering or searching can replace results with an empty message that screen reader users must hear.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn aria-live src/components
npx playwright test tests/live-region.spec.ts
npx @axe-core/cli http://localhost:5173/empty --exit

cards.title: Honor reduced motion on empty-state entrance animation
cards.when: The empty state fades or slides in and must not animate for users who set reduced motion.

grep -rn motion-reduce src
npx tailwindcss -i src/index.css -o dist/app.css
npx playwright test tests/reduced-motion.spec.ts

cards.title: Name icon-only empty-state action with sr-only text
cards.when: The empty state has an icon-only add or create button that needs an accessible name.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn sr-only src/components
npx tailwindcss -i src/index.css -o dist/app.css
npx eslint src/components/EmptyState.tsx

cards.title: Slide and fade onboarding steps with Tailwind transitions
cards.when: Use this when a new onboarding step must enter and leave the screen with a horizontal slide and fade.
cards.cmds:
grep -n tailwindcss package.json
grep -rc duration-300 src/components
npx playwright test tests/onboarding-step.spec.ts

cards.title: Respect reduced motion in onboarding with motion-reduce variants
cards.when: Use this when onboarding animations must turn off for users who set the OS reduce-motion preference.

grep -rn transition src/components
grep -c motion-reduce src/components/OnboardingStep.jsx
npx playwright test tests/onboarding-reduced.spec.ts

cards.title: Add custom keyframes for an onboarding progress pulse

cat tailwind.config.js
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/index.css -o ./dist/onboarding.css
grep -c animate-pulse-dot dist/onboarding.css

cards.title: Animate onboarding progress bar width with a transition
cards.when: Use this when the onboarding progress bar must grow smoothly from one step count to the next.

grep -rln OnboardingProgress src
npx playwright test tests/progress-bar.spec.ts

cards.title: Stagger onboarding checklist entrances with transition delays
cards.when: Use this when a checklist of onboarding items must fade in one after another instead of all at once.

grep -rn map src/components/OnboardingChecklist.jsx
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/index.css -o ./dist/onboarding.css
grep -c delay-200 dist/onboarding.css

cards.title: Animate onboarding modal enter and exit with data-state
cards.when: Use this when an onboarding modal must fade and scale in and out based on an open or closed state attribute.

grep -rln Dialog src
npx tailwindcss -i ./src/index.css -o ./dist/onboarding.css
npx playwright test tests/onboarding-modal.spec.ts

cards.title: Switch tabs to accordion below a width breakpoint
cards.when: A Svelte tabs component must show an accordion layout on narrow viewports and tabs on wide ones.
cards.cmds:
grep -n bind:innerWidth src/lib/Tabs.svelte
npx svelte-check --threshold error
npx lighthouse http://localhost:5173 --only-categories=accessibility --preset=mobile

cards.title: Make the tab list scroll horizontally with 44px targets
cards.when: Tabs have many labels and must remain usable on phones without wrapping or shrinking the touch targets.

npx axe http://localhost:5173/tabs-demo

cards.when: The tabs component sits inside sidebars of different widths, so layout must follow its container rather than the window.

npm run dev
npx playwright test tests/tabs-container.spec.ts

cards.when: A tabs component needs to react to a media query change in a clean, testable way instead of reading window width.

rg -c addEventListener src/lib/Tabs.svelte
npm run build

cards.title: Render tab panels with a snippet per breakpoint
cards.when: The same tab content must render in a different structure on mobile and desktop without duplicating the markup.

cards.title: Verify responsive tabs at three viewport widths
cards.when: After building responsive tabs, you must prove the layout switches correctly at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths.

npx axe http://localhost:5173/tabs-demo

cards.title: Plan color roles with 4.5:1 contrast minimum
cards.when: Use when deciding color tokens for text on surfaces in a Flutter app, before writing ColorScheme code.

rg -n -F "Color(0x" lib
rg -c -F "onSurface" lib
rg -c -F "surfaceContainer" lib
rg -n -F "4.5:1" docs/color_tokens.md

cards.title: Verify onboarding cold start reaches first frame under 1 s

rg -n "^profile-startup:" Makefile
make profile-startup
jq .timeToFirstFrameMicros build/start_up_info.json

cards.title: Confirm onboarding images are size-capped before decode
cards.when: Use after adding or replacing onboarding artwork, to stop oversized PNGs from raising memory use and decode time.

find assets/onboarding -name "*.png" -size +300k
rg -c "Image[.]asset[(]" lib/onboarding
rg -c "cacheWidth:" lib/onboarding

cards.title: Verify onboarding dots are isolated by RepaintBoundary
cards.when: Use after adding an animated page indicator or transition to onboarding, to prove the animation repaints only its own layer.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "RepaintBoundary" lib/onboarding
rg -c "testWidgets[(]" test/onboarding
make test-widget

cards.title: Check onboarding p90 frame build time under 16 ms
cards.when: Use after editing onboarding pages or animations, to measure whether page transitions still hold 60 fps.
cards.cmds:
rg -l "traceAction" integration_test
make perf-onboarding
jq ."90th_percentile_frame_build_time_millis" build/onboarding_timeline_summary.json
jq -e '."90th_percentile_frame_build_time_millis" < 16' build/onboarding_timeline_summary.json
jq -e '.missed_frame_build_budget_count == 0' build/onboarding_timeline_summary.json

cards.title: Assert onboarding skeleton shows until data resolves
cards.when: Use when the onboarding step fetches data in setup and must show a skeleton until its ref resolves.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run src/components/OnboardingStep.spec.ts
npx vitest run src/components/OnboardingStep.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify loading region announces state to screen readers
cards.when: Use when the onboarding loader must expose its busy state to assistive technology.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev
npx axe http://localhost:5173/onboarding --tags wcag21aa --exit

cards.title: Check spinner timing with Playwright route delay
cards.when: Use when you must prove the spinner appears within 200ms and disappears after the API responds.

npx playwright test tests/onboarding-loading.spec.ts --reporter=line
npx playwright test tests/onboarding-loading.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.when: Use when the skeleton is replaced by real onboarding content and you must confirm the page does not jump.

npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173/onboarding --only-categories=performance --output=json --output-path=./lh-onboarding.json
jq .audits["cumulative-layout-shift"].numericValue lh-onboarding.json

cards.title: Test Suspense fallback renders before async setup
cards.when: Use when a child component with async setup is wrapped in Vue's Suspense and must show the #fallback slot first.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run -t "renders fallback before async setup resolves"
npx vitest run -t "renders fallback before async setup resolves"

cards.title: Confirm loading flag clears after fetch errors
cards.when: Use when the onboarding composable sets isLoading true and must reset it and show an error when the fetch rejects.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run src/composables/useOnboarding.spec.ts
npx vitest run src/composables/useOnboarding.spec.ts
npx vue-tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Verify empty toast region stays hidden with no toasts
cards.when: Use after building a toast region that should render nothing when no messages are queued.

grep -c 'toast-region:empty' styles/toast.css
npx playwright test tests/toast-empty.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify error toast uses assertive alert role
cards.when: Use after building the error variant of a toast to confirm screen readers announce it immediately.

npx playwright test tests/toast-error-role.spec.ts
npx axe http://localhost:8080/toast-error.html

npx axe http://localhost:8080/toast-error.html --tags wcag2aa
npx axe http://localhost:8080/toast-error.html --tags wcag2aa --exit

npx playwright test tests/toast-motion-timing.spec.ts

node tests/toast-empty-message.test.js
grep -c 'empty' tests/toast-empty-message.test.js

cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/lib/forms
npx playwright test tests/country-select.spec.ts
npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173/contact --only-categories=performance

cards.title: Fail the build when a JavaScript chunk exceeds 50 KB
cards.when: A team wants a size gate that stops oversized form code from shipping.
cards.cmds:
npx vite build
mkdir -p scripts
node scripts/size-budget.mjs
find .svelte-kit/output/client/_app/immutable -name '*.js' -size +50k

cards.title: Merge empty-state icon, title, and message into one VoiceOver element
cards.when: Use when an empty-state view stacks an icon, a title, and a message that VoiceOver should read as one unit.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'VStack' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
grep -cF '.accessibilityElement(children: .combine)' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
grep -cF 'Button(' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift

cards.title: Hide decorative empty-state symbol from VoiceOver
cards.when: Use when an empty-state SF Symbol repeats meaning already given by the adjacent text.
cards.cmds:
rg -nF 'Image(systemName:' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
grep -cF '.accessibilityHidden(true)' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
grep -cF 'Image(systemName:' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift

cards.title: Mark empty-state title as VoiceOver heading
cards.when: Use when an empty-state title starts a section that VoiceOver users navigate by headings.
cards.cmds:
rg -nF '.font(.title' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
grep -cF '.accessibilityAddTraits(.isHeader)' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
rg -nF 'accessibilityAddTraits' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift

cards.title: Use text styles so empty-state text scales with Dynamic Type
cards.when: Use when an empty-state view uses fixed font sizes that must grow for users with larger text settings.
cards.cmds:
rg -nF '.font(.system(size:' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
grep -cF '.font(.system(size:' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
grep -cF '.lineLimit(nil)' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift

cards.title: Give empty-state action button a 44pt tap target
cards.when: Use when an empty-state call-to-action button is smaller than Apple's 44x44pt minimum tap target.
cards.cmds:
rg -nF 'Button(' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
grep -cF 'minHeight: 44' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
grep -cF '.contentShape(Rectangle())' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift

cards.title: Skip empty-state symbol animation when Reduce Motion is on
cards.when: Use when an empty-state view animates an SF Symbol that should stop for users who enable Reduce Motion.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'animation' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
rg -nF 'symbolEffect' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift
grep -cF 'accessibilityReduceMotion' Sources/Empty/EmptyStateView.swift

cards.title: Verify validation errors are announced in a live region
cards.when: Use this after a form submit fails and a toast must announce the field errors to screen readers.
cards.cmds:
grep -c alert toast.html
grep -c aria-live toast.js
npx playwright test tests/toast-announce.spec.js
grep -c toHaveText tests/toast-announce.spec.js

cards.title: Run axe on the form page with toast open
cards.when: Use this after adding toast markup to a form page to catch WCAG 2.1 AA violations.
cards.cmds:
ls contact.html
npx axe http://localhost:8080/contact.html --tags wcag21aa --exit
grep -c role= toast.html
npx axe http://localhost:8080/contact.html --tags wcag21aa --exit

cards.title: Verify error toasts persist and success toasts dismiss at 5000ms
cards.when: Use this when toast timers are set and you must prove errors stay visible while success messages auto-dismiss.
cards.cmds:
grep -c 5000 toast.js
grep -c error toast.js
npx playwright test tests/toast-timing.spec.js
grep -c 5100 tests/toast-timing.spec.js

cards.title: Verify toast count matches invalid form fields
cards.when: Use this after wiring validation so each invalid field produces exactly one toast entry.
cards.cmds:
grep -c required contact.html
grep -c user-invalid toast.css
npx playwright test tests/toast-count.spec.js
grep -c toHaveCount tests/toast-count.spec.js

cards.title: Verify toast dismiss button meets 44px target size
cards.when: Use this when the toast close button must be easy to hit on touch screens.
cards.cmds:
grep -c 44px toast.css
npx playwright test tests/toast-target.spec.js
grep -c boundingBox tests/toast-target.spec.js
npx prettier --check toast.css

cards.title: Run Lighthouse accessibility audit on form with toast
cards.when: Use this as a final gate before shipping a form page that shows toast validation messages.
cards.cmds:
npx lighthouse http://localhost:8080/contact.html --only-categories=accessibility --chrome-flags=--headless --quiet --output=json --output-path=./lighthouse-contact.json
jq .categories.accessibility.score lighthouse-contact.json
ls lighthouse-contact.json

cards.title: Create onboarding signup route with a form action
cards.when: Use this when adding the first onboarding page that collects an email and password in a SvelteKit app.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/routes/onboarding/signup
touch src/routes/onboarding/signup/+page.server.ts
touch src/routes/onboarding/signup/+page.svelte
npx svelte-check --threshold error

cards.title: Share a Zod schema for onboarding validation
cards.when: Use this when the same onboarding rules must run in both the client component and the server form action.
cards.cmds:
npm install zod
mkdir -p src/lib/schemas
touch src/lib/schemas/onboarding.ts
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Enhance the signup form with use:enhance
cards.when: Use this when the signup form should submit without a full page reload but still work with JavaScript disabled.
cards.cmds:
npx eslint src/routes/onboarding/signup
npx svelte-check --threshold error

cards.title: Make error messages accessible with ARIA and 44px targets
cards.when: Use this when onboarding form errors must be announced by screen readers and the inputs must meet touch size rules.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tests/onboarding-a11y.spec.ts
npx lighthouse http://localhost:5173/onboarding/signup --only-categories=accessibility --quiet

cards.title: Gate a multi-step onboarding wizard with derived validity
cards.when: Use this when onboarding has several steps and the Next button must stay disabled until the current step validates.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/lib/stores
touch src/lib/stores/onboarding.svelte.ts
npx playwright test tests/onboarding-wizard.spec.ts

cards.title: Add empty-state fallback slot to BaseCard
cards.when: A Vue card receives no items from its parent and must show a fallback message instead of a blank body.
cards.cmds:
grep -c 'name="empty"' src/components/BaseCard.vue
npx vue-tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Test error alert shows text and emits retry once
cards.when: You need to prove that a failed request shows the alert with its message and that clicking retry emits exactly one retry event.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run src/components/BaseCard.spec.ts
npx eslint src/components/BaseCard.vue

cards.title: Verify error state meets contrast and minimum size
cards.when: Before shipping, you need to confirm the error text and retry button pass contrast and touch-size requirements.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 'min-height: 44px' src/components/BaseCard.vue
npx playwright test tests/card-error.spec.ts
npx eslint src/components/BaseCard.vue

cards.title: Render error message with role alert and retry
cards.when: A Vue card's data request fails and the user needs to see the error text and a button to try again.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -F error src/components/BaseCard.vue
grep -n -F defineEmits src/components/BaseCard.vue
grep -n -F v-else-if src/components/BaseCard.vue
grep -n -F alert src/components/BaseCard.vue
npx vitest run src/components/BaseCard.spec.ts

cards.title: Model loading, empty, error, and ready with one status
cards.when: A card needs one status prop so loading, empty, error, and ready states can never be true at the same time.
cards.cmds:
grep -n -F CardStatus src/components/BaseCard.vue
grep -n -F status src/components/BaseCard.vue
grep -n -F showBody src/components/BaseCard.vue
grep -c -F "'ready'" src/components/BaseCard.vue
npx vue-tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Test empty state renders fallback and no body
cards.when: You need automated proof that BaseCard shows its empty message and removes the body when status is empty.
cards.cmds:
touch src/components/BaseCard.spec.ts
grep -n -F "No items yet" src/components/BaseCard.spec.ts
grep -n -F card__body src/components/BaseCard.spec.ts
npx vitest run src/components/BaseCard.spec.ts -t empty

cards.title: Verify skeleton rows appear while table data loads
cards.when: Use when a Svelte table shows placeholder rows during a pending fetch and you need to prove they render before data arrives.
cards.cmds:
ls playwright.config.ts
touch tests/users-loading.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/users-loading.spec.ts --grep skeleton

cards.title: Unit-test table loading props with Vitest
cards.when: Use when a Svelte 5 table component takes a loading prop and you need to confirm its pending markup without a browser.
cards.cmds:
npm ls vitest
touch src/lib/UsersTable.spec.ts
npx vitest run src/lib/UsersTable.spec.ts

cards.title: Scan loading table for accessibility violations
cards.when: Use when a table is in its loading state and you must prove it has no axe violations for busy and live region markup.
cards.cmds:
env API_DELAY_MS=2000 npm run preview
npx axe http://localhost:4173/users --exit
npx axe http://localhost:4173/users --exit

cards.title: Measure layout shift when skeleton swaps to data
cards.when: Use when skeleton rows are replaced by real rows and you need to prove the swap does not move the page.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
npm run preview
npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173/users --only-categories=performance --output=json --output-path=lh-users.json --chrome-flags=--headless
jq .audits["cumulative-layout-shift"].numericValue lh-users.json

cards.title: Type-check table loading props with svelte-check
cards.when: Use when a Svelte table component declares loading and row props and you must prove the types agree at every call site.
cards.cmds:
npm install
npx svelte-check --threshold error
npx svelte-check --threshold error

cards.title: Confirm failed fetch clears table loading state
cards.when: Use when a table waits on a request and you must prove the loading state ends with an error message when the request fails.
cards.cmds:
touch tests/users-error.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/users-error.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/users-error.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Inventory existing button code before choosing loading API
cards.when: Starting a loading button in a React codebase you have not read yet.
cards.cmds:
grep -rln 'export.*Button' src --include=*.tsx
cat src/components/Button.tsx
npm ls react --depth=0

cards.title: Set hit size, contrast and aria rules for loading state
cards.when: Deciding how the button looks and announces itself while loading.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'min-height' src/styles
cat package.json

cards.title: Set spinner delay and minimum visible time
cards.when: When a fast request would make the spinner flicker, you need concrete timing numbers.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'setTimeout' src
jq '.devDependencies' package.json

cards.title: Plan test file names and counts before building
cards.when: Before coding, to lock what the verify stage must prove.
cards.cmds:
find src -name '*.test.tsx'
jq '.scripts.test' package.json

cards.title: Define loading button state set and transitions
cards.when: Before writing code, when you need to fix the states a button can be in during an async action.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p docs/plans
touch docs/plans/loading-button.md
grep -n '2000ms' docs/plans/loading-button.md
wc -l docs/plans/loading-button.md

cards.title: Decide who owns the async action and its errors
cards.when: Choosing whether the button runs a promise from onClick or a form action.
cards.cmds:
grep -rln 'async' src --include=*.tsx
grep -rn 'action=' src --include=*.tsx
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Verify modal empty state shows message and hides list
cards.when: Use after building a modal that lists items, to confirm the zero-items state renders its message.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'data-state=empty' src/components/Modal.tsx
npx playwright test tests/modal-empty.spec.ts --reporter=line
rg -c toHaveCount tests/modal-empty.spec.ts

cards.title: Check error banner text contrast meets 4.5:1
cards.when: Use when a modal shows an inline error in Tailwind red colors and must meet WCAG AA contrast.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'text-red-700' src/components/Modal.tsx
npx axe 'http://localhost:3000/modal?error=1' --tags wcag2aa

cards.title: Verify error message is announced via role alert
cards.when: Use when a modal shows an error after a failed action and screen reader users must hear it right away.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'role="alert"' src/components/Modal.tsx
npx playwright test tests/modal-error.spec.ts --reporter=line
rg -n 'timeout: 200' tests/modal-error.spec.ts

cards.title: Confirm Tailwind build emits modal error classes
cards.when: Use after adding error-state classes to a modal, to confirm the Tailwind build actually generates them.
cards.cmds:
npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./src/modal.css -o ./dist/modal.css
rg -c 'bg-red-50' dist/modal.css
rg -c 'text-red-700' dist/modal.css
wc -c dist/modal.css

cards.title: Measure error retry button meets 44px tap target
cards.when: Use when a modal's error state has a retry button that must be large enough for touch input.
cards.cmds:
rg -n 'min-h-11' src/components/Modal.tsx
npx playwright test tests/modal-retry.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Score modal empty and error pages with Lighthouse accessibility
cards.when: Use before shipping a modal, to get a measured accessibility score for its empty and error routes.
cards.cmds:
npx lighthouse 'http://localhost:3000/modal?items=0' --only-categories=accessibility --output=json --output-path=./lh-empty.json --chrome-flags=--headless
jq .categories.accessibility.score lh-empty.json
npx lighthouse 'http://localhost:3000/modal?error=1' --only-categories=accessibility --output=json --output-path=./lh-error.json --chrome-flags=--headless
jq .categories.accessibility.score lh-error.json

cards.title: Plan an empty state with ContentUnavailableView
cards.when: Use this when a SwiftUI modal list or section can have zero items and needs a clear empty message with an action.

rg -n -F 'IPHONEOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET' -g '*.pbxproj' .
rg -c -F 'No ' Sources
rg -c -F 'ContentUnavailableView' Sources

rg -c -F 'enum' Sources
rg -n '.{81,}' Sources

cards.when: Use this when a SwiftUI modal must choose between a dismissible alert and an error shown inside the modal's content.

rg -c -F '.sheet(' Sources

cards.title: Plan dismissal lockout and loading-delay timing
cards.when: Use this when a modal runs a save or load and must block dismissal or show a spinner without flicker.

cards.title: Fix button touch-target and breakpoint numbers before coding

rg -n '<button' src

touch PLAN.md
rg -n -e 44px -e 768px PLAN.md

cat package.json

cards.title: Plan size variants as typed props in Svelte 5
cards.when: Use this when a Button needs sm, md and lg sizes that a parent chooses through component props.
cards.cmds:
cat package.json
rg -n 'props' src/lib
touch PLAN.md
rg -n -e 36px -e 44px -e 52px PLAN.md

cards.title: Define a viewport test matrix for Playwright before building
cards.when: Use this when you need to decide which widths and zoom levels the responsive Button must pass before writing any component code.

npx playwright test --list
touch tests/button.spec.ts
rg -n -e 320px -e 768px -e 1280px PLAN.md

cards.title: Plan overflow handling for long labels at narrow widths

wc -l PLAN.md

cards.title: Plan JS width tracking only where CSS cannot do the job
cards.when: Use this when the Button must change its markup, not just its styling, at a set width, and you need to decide whether JavaScript is justified.

rg -n -e innerWidth -e matchMedia src
touch PLAN.md
rg -n -e 768px PLAN.md
npx svelte-check --threshold error

cards.title: Select error view with a Retry button in SwiftUI

grep -c 'Button("Retry"' Sources/Components/Select/SelectErrorView.swift
grep -n 'exclamationmark.triangle' Sources/Components/Select/SelectErrorView.swift

cards.title: Model select loading, empty, and failed states as one enum

find Sources/Components -name SelectState.swift

cards.title: Plan asset catalog colorsets for button roles
cards.when: Use when deciding which adaptive colors the button needs and where they will live in the asset catalog.

test -d Assets.xcassets

rg -n -e "4\.5:1" --type md .

rg -n "#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}" app/select.tcss

cards.when: Use this when a stylesheet uses $variables, to confirm each variable resolves to the value in the current theme.
cards.cmds:
rg -n [$]background styles
pytest -q tests/test_css_vars.py

cards.title: Verify dark mode toggle repaints within 200ms
cards.when: Use this when a theme toggle feels slow, to measure the time from toggle to a finished repaint.
cards.cmds:
rg -n perf_counter tests
pytest -q tests/test_toggle_timing.py

cards.title: Set transition duration budget with reduced motion fallback
cards.when: Use this when you need a shared timing budget and a reduced motion rule before adding any transition to a layout.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "prefers-reduced-motion" src
rg -n "duration" src

cards.title: Plan list reorder with keyed each and animate flip
cards.when: Use this when a layout renders a list that reorders and you want the items to move smoothly instead of jumping.
cards.cmds:
rg -n "[{]#each .* [(]" src/lib
grep -n "animate" node_modules/svelte/package.json

cards.title: Record layout shift baseline before planning motion
cards.when: Use this when a layout will gain motion and you need a measured baseline so the change can be checked against a stated layout shift limit.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
find dist -name "*.js"
npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173 --only-categories=performance --output=json --output-path=stdout

cards.title: Confirm Svelte major version before choosing motion API
cards.when: Use this before writing any transition code, because Svelte 4 and Svelte 5 handle slots and props differently.
cards.cmds:
cat package.json
npm ls svelte
rg -c props src
rg -c slot src

cards.title: Plan accessible error messages for each card field
cards.when: Before building the form, decide how each field announces its error to screen readers and how the error element is linked.
cards.cmds:
touch PLAN.md
grep -c 'email-error' PLAN.md
grep -c 'aria-describedby' PLAN.md
grep -c '4.5:1' PLAN.md
grep -c 'error' PLAN.md

cards.title: Verify Vue Transition timings match the layout stylesheet
cards.when: A layout component uses a Vue Transition and you must confirm its enter and leave durations in the stylesheet.
cards.cmds:
grep -n transition src/components/AppLayout.vue
grep -n name= src/components/AppLayout.vue
npx vue-tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run tests/AppLayout.motion.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify layout transitions are disabled under reduced motion
cards.when: A layout animates on entry and must respect the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn prefers-reduced-motion src
npx playwright test tests/reduced-motion.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/reduced-motion.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Verify TransitionGroup list items keep stable keys
cards.when: A layout renders a list with TransitionGroup and items must animate in and out without losing identity.
cards.cmds:
rg -n v-for src/components/AppLayout.vue
rg -n :key src/components/AppLayout.vue
npx vitest run tests/TransitionGroup.spec.ts

cards.title: Measure per-frame motion cost against the 16ms budget
cards.when: A layout animation feels janky and you must prove each frame stays under the 60fps budget.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tests/layout-frames.spec.ts
npx playwright test tests/layout-frames.spec.ts --reporter=list

cards.title: Verify layout shift stays under 0.1 during motion
cards.when: A layout animates content in and you must confirm that the animation does not cause measurable layout shift.
cards.cmds:
npm run build
npx vite preview --port 4173
npx lighthouse http://localhost:4173 --only-categories=performance --output=json --output-path=./lh-layout.json --quiet
jq '.audits["cumulative-layout-shift"].numericValue' lh-layout.json

cards.title: Find layout transitions that animate geometry properties
cards.when: You suspect a layout animates width, height, top, or left, which causes reflow and jank.
cards.cmds:
rg -n transition src/components
rg -n animation src/components
rg -n :style src/components
rg -n transform src/components
npm test
rg -n -e transition.*width -e transition.*height -e transition.*top -e transition.*left src/components

cards.title: Verify invalid form submit adds exactly one error toast
cards.when: Use this after wiring a Svelte form validation error into the toast store, to prove one error toast appears per failed submit.
cards.cmds:
grep -n export src/lib/toast/store.ts
touch src/lib/toast/validation.test.ts
npx vitest run src/lib/toast/validation.test.ts

cards.title: Type-check toast props and form error shapes with svelte-check
cards.when: Use this when toast message types or form error shapes change, to prove the Svelte components still type-check.
cards.cmds:
npm ls svelte-check
npx svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --threshold error

cards.title: Prove signup toast is announced through an aria-live region
cards.when: Use this after adding a validation toast to a SvelteKit signup page, to confirm screen readers receive the message.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn aria-live src/lib/toast
npx playwright test tests/signup-toast.spec.ts

cards.title: Check error toast text contrast meets 4.5:1 with axe
cards.when: Use this after changing toast colors, to confirm the error text passes WCAG AA contrast on the running page.
cards.cmds:
npx vite preview --port 4173
npx axe http://localhost:4173/signup --tags wcag2aa --exit
grep -rn error src/lib/toast

cards.title: Verify toast auto-dismiss fires at 5000ms with fake timers
cards.when: Use this when toast lifetime changes or a dismiss timer is added, to prove the toast stays for exactly the set duration.
cards.cmds:
grep -n 5000 src/lib/toast/Toast.svelte
touch src/lib/toast/dismiss.test.ts
npx vitest run src/lib/toast/dismiss.test.ts

cards.title: Lint toast and form components for Svelte accessibility rules
cards.when: Use this after editing any toast or form Svelte component, to catch missing labels and invalid ARIA before review.
cards.cmds:
ls eslint.config.js
ls src/lib/toast
npx eslint src/lib/toast

cards.title: Plan staggered list entrance with capped total delay
cards.when: Use this when list items should appear one after another without the last item waiting too long.
cards.cmds:
grep -c "<li" src/components/TodoList.test.tsx
rg -o "transition-delay:[0-9]+ms" src

cards.title: Plan enter animation using starting variant
cards.when: Use this in a Tailwind v4 project where new list items should fade in when inserted into the DOM.
cards.cmds:
npm ls tailwindcss
grep -n import src/index.css
grep -rn starting: src

cards.title: Inventory list items and existing transition classes
cards.when: Use this before adding any motion to a list so you know which items and classes already exist.
cards.cmds:
grep -rln "<ul" src
grep -c "<li" src/components/TodoList.tsx
rg -n transition src
grep tailwindcss package.json
rg -n "duration-[0-9]+" src

cards.title: Set motion budget from Tailwind duration scale
cards.when: Use this when deciding how fast list items enter, leave, or hover.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn duration- src
grep -n transitionDuration tailwind.config.js
rg -n "duration-700" src
rg -n "duration-1000" src

cards.title: Plan motion-reduce fallbacks for every animated item
cards.when: Use this for any list with entrance or movement animation, so users who prefer reduced motion see no movement.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn animate- src
grep -rc motion-reduce src
grep -rc motion-safe src
rg -n "duration-[0-9]+" src

cards.title: Plan layout-safe motion limited to transform and opacity
cards.when: Use this when list rows animate on hover or enter, so the motion does not shift layout or shrink tap targets.
cards.cmds:
rg -n transition-all src
rg -n "min-h-11" src
rg -n min-h- src
rg -c "transition-\[width" src
rg -c "transition-\[height" src

cards.title: Compute a modular type scale before writing tokens
cards.when: Use this when you must choose font sizes for a Vue layout and want them derived from one base size and one ratio.
cards.cmds:
node -p "[-1,0,1,2,3].map(function(i){return Math.pow(1.25,i).toFixed(3)}).join(' ')"
mkdir -p src/styles

cards.title: Verify text contrast before locking color tokens
cards.when: Use this when choosing text and background color tokens for a Vue layout that must meet WCAG AA.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev
npx @axe-core/cli http://localhost:5173 --tags wcag2aa
grep -n 'color' src/styles/tokens.css

cards.title: Plan spacing and line-height tokens from a 0.25rem grid
cards.when: Use this when a Vue layout has inconsistent margins, padding, or line heights and you need one spacing scale.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn 'padding' src --include=*.vue
grep -rn 'line-height' src --include=*.vue
node -p "[1,2,3,4,6,8].map(function(i){return i*0.25+'rem'}).join(' ')"

cards.title: Assert toast text contrast meets 4.5:1 in both themes
cards.when: Use this after changing toast colors in light or dark theme to prove text readability meets WCAG AA.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev -- --port 5173
npx playwright test tests/toast-contrast.spec.ts --project=chromium
grep -n 4.5 tests/toast-contrast.spec.ts

cards.title: Verify toast resolves colors from ThemeProvider context
cards.when: Use this when the toast must change colors whenever the app's ThemeProvider value changes between light, dark and system.
cards.cmds:
npx vitest run src/components/Toast/Toast.theme.test.tsx
grep -n dark src/components/Toast/Toast.theme.test.tsx
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Verify toast follows system color scheme when set to system
cards.when: Use this when the theme setting is system and toasts must match the OS preference without a data-theme attribute.
cards.cmds:
npx playwright test tests/toast-system-scheme.spec.ts --project=chromium
grep -n colorScheme tests/toast-system-scheme.spec.ts
grep -c prefers-color-scheme src/components/Toast/Toast.module.css

cards.title: Scan toast demo in dark and light with axe
cards.when: Use this before release to confirm the dark toast has no WCAG AA color contrast violations.
cards.cmds:
npm run dev -- --port 5173
npx axe http://localhost:5173/toast-demo?theme=dark --tags wcag2aa --exit
npx axe http://localhost:5173/toast-demo?theme=light --tags wcag2aa --exit
npx tsc --noEmit

cards.title: Confirm toast styles use only theme variables
cards.when: Use this before merging toast CSS to catch hardcoded colors that would ignore dark mode.
cards.cmds:
grep -c '#' src/components/Toast/Toast.module.css
grep -c 'rgb' src/components/Toast/Toast.module.css
grep -c 'var(--toast-' src/components/Toast/Toast.module.css
npx playwright test tests/toast-contrast.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Check light and dark blocks declare identical toast tokens
cards.when: Use this after adding a toast token so the dark theme never falls back to a missing value.
cards.cmds:
grep -c -e '--toast-' src/styles/theme.css
grep -n -e '--toast-' src/styles/theme.css
grep -c 'data-theme=dark' src/styles/theme.css
npx playwright test tests/toast-tokens.spec.ts --reporter=line

cards.title: Measure startup time to set onboarding budgets
cards.when: Choosing time budgets for an Ink onboarding loader before writing any loading code.
cards.cmds:
stat dist/cli.js
date +%s%3N
node dist/cli.js --help
date +%s%3N

cards.title: Map existing onboarding loading states before choosing a spinner
cards.when: Starting a plan for loading UI in an Ink onboarding flow that already has some loading code.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -e isLoading -e Spinner -e loading src/onboarding
rg -c -e isLoading -e Spinner -e loading src/onboarding
rg -n ink-spinner package.json
touch PLAN.md
sed -i '$a One shared Spinner component with 80ms frames' PLAN.md
rg -c -F -e 80ms PLAN.md

cards.title: Plan a Gauge progress view for onboarding downloads
cards.when: Planning a Ratatui onboarding screen that shows download progress with a Gauge widget.
cards.cmds:
rg -n ratatui Cargo.toml
rg -n -e Gauge -e Paragraph src
cargo tree --depth 1
touch PLAN.md
sed -i '$a Redraw the Gauge every 100ms with ratio values from 0.0 to 1.0' PLAN.md
rg -c -F -e 100ms PLAN.md
cargo check

cards.title: Plan Ctrl+C cancel for a running Textual load
cards.when: Planning how an onboarding worker stops cleanly when the user presses Ctrl+C during loading.
cards.cmds:
rg -n -F -e BINDINGS -e ctrl+c onboarding
rg -n run_worker onboarding
python --version
touch PLAN.md
sed -i '$a Ctrl+C cancels the worker and exits within 100ms, reusing the existing BINDINGS quit entry' PLAN.md
rg -n -F -e 100ms PLAN.md

cards.title: Choose skeleton or spinner using a 200ms delay
cards.when: Use this when planning which loading indicator a step shows, so fast responses never flash a placeholder.
cards.cmds:
cat docs/onboarding-loading-plan.md
grep -n 200 src/onboarding/loadingTiming.ts

cards.title: Plan screen reader announcements for loading states
cards.when: Use this when planning how onboarding loading and completion are announced to assistive technology.
cards.cmds:
cat docs/onboarding-loading-plan.md
npx axe http://localhost:3000/onboarding

cards.title: Plan one Suspense boundary per onboarding step
cards.when: Use this when deciding where React Suspense boundaries wrap each onboarding step so only that step shows a fallback.
cards.cmds:
grep -rn Suspense src
touch docs/onboarding-suspense-plan.md
grep -rc lazy src/onboarding
grep -c 320px docs/onboarding-suspense-plan.md

cards.title: Plan timeout and retry for failed onboarding fetches
cards.when: Use this when planning what onboarding shows when a request hangs or fails, so the user is never stuck on a spinner.
cards.cmds:
touch docs/onboarding-timeout-plan.md
grep -n Retry docs/onboarding-timeout-plan.md
grep -n 2000 docs/onboarding-timeout-plan.md
grep -c 8000 docs/onboarding-timeout-plan.md

cards.title: Define empty-state type tokens in global CSS
cards.when: Use this when empty-state title and body sizes need to be set once for the whole app instead of per component.
cards.cmds:
mkdir -p src/lib/styles
touch src/lib/styles/tokens.css
grep -c empty- src/lib/styles/tokens.css
